method: PRODUCED - CONSUMED symbol parity (rg across src/, bin/, interfaces/, shared/), read-before-write triage. For every pub fn / pub struct / pub enum / pub mod under src/gateway/interfaces/, cross-referenced against (a) register_channel_plugins() in interfaces/mod.rs, (b) the #[cfg(test)] mod tests of its own file, (c) subsystems.rs::initialize_channels, (d) the inbound/emitter wiring in gateway/inbound_router/executor.rs, (e) the boot path under bin/aleph-server/commands/start/builder/. Classification against the six severed-wire forms; decisions CUT / CONNECT / DECIDE.

findings.produced: MsTeamsChannel + entire src/gateway/interfaces/msteams/ tree (~4 400 LOC): BotFrameworkClient, JwtValidator, GraphClient, GraphTokenManager, FederatedCredential, AuthFlow, GraphMessage, Activity, ActivityAttachment, Channel+WebhookHandler impls, etc.
findings.consumer_location: none found (only the mod.rs:67 pub use re-export; 12 invocations of MsTeamsChannel::new are all inside msteams/mod.rs:822-1107 #[cfg(test)] cases)
findings.rationale: MsTeamsChannel has zero production instantiations; the boot path never registers msteams and there is no impl ChannelFactory. The webchat settings panel lists 'msteams' as a configurable channel type but the channel never connects. The single live external use is msteams::types::pick_status_text (F-09) which can be hoisted.
findings.proposed_change: Delete src/gateway/interfaces/msteams/ in full except for types::pick_status_text; remove pub mod msteams; and pub use msteams::{MsTeamsChannel, MsTeamsConfig}; from src/gateway/interfaces/mod.rs:43,67. Also delete the msteams entry from interfaces/webchat/src/platform/wide/views/settings/channels/definitions.rs:1109-1115.
findings.risk: Operator-facing settings panel removal (UX regression); webchat definitions list mirrors the cut. The TODO in subsystems.rs does not reference msteams (only feishu) so no other live code path is affected.
findings.verification: rg 'MsTeamsChannel\b|interfaces::msteams::' src/ bin/ interfaces/ shared/ must show only the kept pick_status_text import (relocated per F-09).

findings.produced: FeishuChannel + FeishuRuntime + FeishuSender + DmPolicyEngine + the feishu_inbound/feishu_runtime/feishu_policy subtrees + feishu_outbound/{media,reactions,sender}.rs + feishu::{types,message_ops}.rs (~5 200 LOC). Channel+send+react+edit+delete impls on FeishuChannel, plus WebSocket client + webhook server.
findings.consumer_location: none found for FeishuChannel (only mod.rs:62 pub use). Live sub-items: FeishuConfig (executor.rs:517), FeishuApi (executor.rs:514), TokenManager (executor.rs:515), FeishuEventEmitter (executor.rs:516).
findings.rationale: FeishuChannel was the first feishu implementation and was abandoned in favor of the executor-emitter path which constructs FeishuApi/TokenManager directly per message (TODO at executor.rs:527). Every item reachable via FeishuChannel (including the entire feishu_inbound/feishu_runtime/feishu_policy subtrees and feishu_outbound::{media,reactions,sender}.rs) has zero production callers.
findings.proposed_change: Delete: feishu/mod.rs (Channel impl + re-exports), feishu/message_ops.rs, feishu/types.rs, all of feishu_inbound/, feishu_runtime/, feishu_policy/, feishu_outbound/{media,reactions,sender,mod}.rs. Move feishu_outbound/streaming.rs to feishu/streaming.rs and keep feishu/{api,auth,config}.rs. Update executor.rs:516 import path.
findings.risk: 30+ tests in deleted submodules are lost. The TODO at executor.rs:527 ('Share Arc<FeishuApi> from FeishuChannel instead of creating per-emitter') implies a future fix that would re-instantiate FeishuChannel and reach for its stored handle — the cut would force that future fix to redesign storage. Acceptable: this is the audit's mandate.
findings.verification: rg 'FeishuChannel\b|FeishuRuntime|FeishuSender|feishu_inbound|feishu_runtime|feishu_policy' src/ bin/ interfaces/ shared/ must be empty; feishu::api::FeishuApi, feishu::auth::TokenManager, feishu::FeishuConfig, feishu::feishu_outbound::streaming::FeishuEventEmitter remain reachable.

findings.consumer_location: none found (the discord_panel handler calls api::audit_guild_permissions at handlers/discord_panel.rs:301, a different function)
findings.rationale: Pure-logic u64 bitfield checker with zero production callers. The discord panel's discord.audit_permissions RPC uses discord::api::audit_guild_permissions (REST-driven), not this module's offline bitfield checker. Webchat's PermissionAuditSection deserializes raw JSON, not the PermissionAudit struct.

findings.risk: None beyond losing the orphan struct.

findings.produced: Three test-only files exercising their respective parent module (xmpp::message_ops 562 LOC, nostr::message_ops 610 LOC, slack::message_ops 540 LOC).
findings.rationale: Listed for completeness — these are not dead code, they exercise the production code in their parent modules. No action required, but flagged so a future 'find pub fn with no external caller' sweep sees the reasoning.
findings.verification: rg 'message_ops::tests' src/ bin/ interfaces/ shared/ must show only the mod tests; declarations inside the parent files.

findings.produced: FeishuConfig (struct + validate + base_url + is_webhook_mode + default_render_mode + FeishuConfig::streaming/typing_indicator fields).
findings.rationale: FeishuConfig is reachable in production code, but only via a closed loop: the executor's is_feishu branch at executor.rs:145 can never fire because no feishu channel is ever registered (F-02). The boot path cannot construct a FeishuChannel because (a) FeishuChannelFactory is missing and (b) FeishuConfig is not registered via register_channel_plugins. The Config::validate accepts a [channels.feishu] block but subsystems.rs:478 logs 'Failed to create channel' silently. Two outcomes: (a) CUT (paired with F-02, making FeishuConfig a test fixture); (b) CONNECT by registering FeishuChannelFactory and accepting the channel as the live transport (substantive refactor). Recommend (a).
findings.proposed_change: Pair with F-02 cut: FeishuConfig becomes a private test-only type after executor.rs:519 deserialization is removed.
findings.risk: Low for (a). For (b), the connect is a feature, not a wire repair.
findings.verification: rg '"feishu"|register_channel_plugins.*feishu|register_with_plugin.*feishu' src/gateway/interfaces/ must show zero hits after cut.

findings.produced: pub fn pick_status_text() -> &'static str — returns one of three English-language streaming-status strings ('Thinking…', 'Working on it…', 'One moment…').
findings.rationale: This pure function is used in production but lives inside the otherwise-dead msteams module. It has no msteams-specific content. Two outcomes: (a) hoist to gateway/reply_emitter/emitter/native_stream.rs (cleanest, pairs with F-01); (b) leave in place and keep types.rs alive specifically for this function. Recommend (a).
findings.proposed_change: Move pick_status_text to a new module under gateway/reply_emitter/emitter/ (e.g. native_stream.rs) and update the call site to drop the interfaces::msteams import.
findings.verification: rg 'pick_status_text' src/ bin/ interfaces/ shared/ must show exactly one definition + one caller after relocation.

findings.produced: Two parallel permission-audit APIs: discord::api::audit_guild_permissions (REST-driven, returns Vec<{name, has, importance}>) and discord::permissions::audit_permissions (offline u64 bitfield, returns discord::permissions::PermissionAudit).
findings.rationale: discord_panel::handle_audit_permissions returns the api::audit_guild_permissions shape via JSON; the orphaned discord::permissions::PermissionAudit type is never produced or consumed by the live panel. Both the struct and the audit_permissions function are dead.
findings.verification: rg 'PermissionAudit\b' src/ bin/ interfaces/ shared/ must be empty after F-03 cut.
